title: Practice Pack: Metals and Non-metals
subject: Science
chapter: Topic-based: use with whichever Class 8 book your students follow
instructions: Part A checks the basics. Part B makes you think and apply.
Write word equations first. Then try the chemical equations where they are asked for.

questions.q: Give four physical properties of metals.
questions.answer: (Any four) They are lustrous (shiny), hard, malleable (can be beaten into sheets), ductile (can be drawn into wires), good conductors of heat and electricity, and sonorous (they make a ringing sound).

questions.q: Name a metal that is a liquid at room temperature, and a non-metal that is a liquid.
Why are bells made of metal and not of wood?
questions.answer: Metals are sonorous: they make a ringing sound when struck.

questions.q: What is the nature of the oxides of metals and of non-metals?
questions.answer: Metal oxides are basic (they turn red litmus blue). Non-metal oxides are acidic (they turn blue litmus red).

questions.q: Why is sodium stored in kerosene?
questions.answer: It reacts vigorously with oxygen and water in the air and can catch fire.

questions.q: Write the word equation and the balanced chemical equation for burning magnesium in air. What is the nature of the product?
questions.answer: Magnesium + oxygen → magnesium oxide. 2Mg + O_{2} → 2MgO. Magnesium oxide is basic.

questions.q: Write the equation for burning sulphur in air. What happens when the product dissolves in water?
questions.answer: S + O_{2} → SO_{2}. Sulphur dioxide dissolves in water to form sulphurous acid, which turns blue litmus red (acidic).

questions.q: A zinc plate is put in copper sulphate solution. What do you observe? Write the equation.
questions.answer: The blue colour of the solution fades, and a reddish-brown layer of copper forms on the zinc. Zinc is more reactive than copper and displaces it: Zn + CuSO_{4} → ZnSO_{4} + Cu.

questions.q: Will a reaction take place if copper is put in zinc sulphate solution? Why?
questions.answer: No. Copper is less reactive than zinc, so it cannot displace zinc.

questions.q: Why are copper and aluminium used to make electric wires?
questions.answer: They are good conductors of electricity and are ductile (can be drawn into thin wires).

questions.q: Why do iron objects rust, but gold jewellery stays shiny for years?
questions.answer: Iron reacts with oxygen and moisture in the air to form rust. Gold is very unreactive and does not react with air or water.

closing: Reactive metals push out less reactive ones. Remember the rule!
